# model-card-gen

> Generate model cards in Markdown from structured JSON following the Mitchell et al. sections, with validation, Decimal metric tables, and subgroup disparity notes. Python package `trysac-model-card-gen`, import name `model_card_gen`, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example, public API, limits, and the Markdown-template comparison
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): single-module shape, public API, errors, and side effects
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the pytest file and tests present
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, and out-of-scope items
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): defended and not-defended threat model with input limits

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): standard library and pytest
